decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already states that fiat fees reduce the founder share and that remaining proceeds fund commissions and prize pools.
Reducing the founder allocation by applicable fiat fees does not change the Transak provider, conversion path, supported methods, or wallet requirement.
The source Event governs primary-mint revenue allocation and does not change the existing secondary-sale royalty amount, visibility, or enforcement behavior.
The source allocation rule does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient selection, or the commission-and-ticket reward components.
The Small Block state already identifies primary mints as a pool-funding source, and the source does not change its prize amount, draw condition, or funding-source membership.
The Big Block state already identifies primary mints as a pool-funding source, and the source does not change its prize parameters, trigger, or eligible sale types.
Revenue allocation does not change ticket issuance, counters, eligibility windows, reset behavior, or transfer semantics.
The source decision does not change winner eligibility, ticket weighting, Chainlink VRF, or on-chain selection behavior.
The primary-mint allocation rule does not change which referral, ticket-counter, or badge attributes must appear in NFT metadata.
The source decision does not alter badge definitions, referral milestones, storage, icons, or current effects.
Changing how mint proceeds are allocated does not alter the manual one-click prize claim flow or its Winners-page location.
The revenue-allocation decision is unrelated to the deferred Discord community-server requirement.
